This course is an inferior treatment to the people who are taking it. We are not given a project which challenges us to develop ourselves and end up with a real product. The project was designed in a way so that it won't work effectively. Also, it would be better if we could use a place where is dedicated for at least graduation projects. Project management in a great scale, system engineering etc., these are the things that you cannot teach in a class by lectures. They can be learned only in the industry, not behind a chair. I might be wrong but nobody is listening to those lectures, anyway. I recommend that they are removed from the syllabus. (In place of those lectures, students can spend 2 more hours on their project every week) Also, not many groups are able to finish the project, it is comprehensive but may need adjustments. The success rate might be even lower than %10, this should not be overlooked by the coordinators, I believe.

course:
The weakest aspect of the course is that the lectures are extremely ineffective. The most important reason of this is that the lab assignments are being explained in the lectures way too early, before anyone starts thinking about that assignment. Improving the synchronization of the lectures and the lab assignments would be a significant improvement in the quality of the course.
Another weak aspect of the course is that even though it is usually taken by the relatively low-level students, the assignments are high-level, which results in almost no group successfully completing the project each semester. This does not make sense for a senior year project course, and a serious adjustment is necessary regarding this point for the course to become effective.
The strongest aspect of the course is the unimportance of the deadlines. Setting precise deadlines but then not being strict about them -which is what is being done- might be the best approach regarding the lab assignments because: (i) If the deadlines were strict, no group would perform well; (ii) if the deadlines were not specified precisely, then no group would work hard.

course: dersi EEE-493 dersinde az proje dağıtıldığı için almak zorunda kaldım, asla VHDL ile çalışmayacağım. Dersin projesi aşırı zor ve VHDL ile çok ilgili ve bilgili olunmadan yapılamaz. Diğer bitirme derslerine kıyasla çok zor kalıyor ve lab diğer eee dersleriyle ortak kullanıldığı için testler sırasında büyük sorunlar çıkıyor.

Lab assignmentların revize edilmesi gerektiğini düşünüyorum. Bazı nüanslar pdflerde açıkça yazılmamış, veya direkt bahsedilmeden geçilmiş. ADC, WINDOW, ve FFT lablarında yaşadığımız birçok soruna lab assignmentların noksan olması sebep oldu.
